texts.label: text
texts.orig: The paper provides formulas for analysis of sensitivity of OFO. The results are validated in synthetic case study, can be used   instead of   finite differences to compute the sensitivities in both unconstrained and constrained optimization problems. The synthetic case study   also indicated that the sensitivities of OFO depend on how the  OFO controller has been running. If the time was insufficient; the sensitivities of OFO increase the   optimum is not  reached. Conversely, if OFO reaches the   optimum; then it becomes less sensitive to changes in parameters . These results suggest   that future work could focus on analysis of sensitivity with respect to time. long
